```python
import datetime
from calendar_assistant import send_email, create_calendar_event

# Set the event details
title = "Intro with Mark"
start_time = "2024-05-30T10:20"
end_time = start_time + "T+1H"  # Adding one hour to the end time
location = None  # No location provided
participants = ["mark.black-2134@gmail.com"]

# Create the event and send an email to the participants
create_calendar_event(title, start_time, end_time, location, participants)
send_email("Intro with Mark", title, f"This is a reminder for the {title} on {datetime.datetime.strptime(start_time, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M').strftime('%B %d, %Y')} at {start_time}.", participants)
```

This code first sets the event details like title, start time, end time, location, and participants. Then it creates the calendar event using the `create_calendar_event` function and sends an email to the participants with the event details using the `send_email` function.
